text.p: Intelect Communications Systems Ltd said Thursday that a subsidiary has been awarded a contract worth close to $2 million to supply MFS Communications Co Inc with 83 of its Sonetlynx nodes of OC-3 digital fiber optic multiplexers.
The multiplexers are for the first phase of an 800-mile fiber optic network called the "info-pipeline" that MFS Network is developing with three Alaska-Native firms.
MFS will operate the network along the trans-Alaska pipeline from Prudhoe Bay to Valdez.
An additional 55 Sonetlynx nodes are expected to be installed in a second-phase expansion of the project, which is planned to be underway by late 1997.

The nodes will be used to monitor and control pipeline pump stations and gate valves, as well as to support advanced digital voice, data and video for telecommunications services that MFS will be providing to cities and towns located near the pipeline's route.
